verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation is a fair question for an AI-native email SaaS, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented headless mode, CLI, or public API: OpenAPI probes all 404. The official MCP server, which drives the inbox from Claude or ChatGPT, belongs to a separate MCP story and does not count here. The in-app trigger-based agents are an adjacent feature, not headless or CI execution.
